reset_password.subject: Reset your Halala password · إعادة تعيين كلمة مرور هللة
reset_password.where: Supabase > Authentication > Emails > Templates > Reset password

confirm_signup.subject: Confirm your email · تأكيد بريدك الإلكتروني
confirm_signup.where: Supabase > Authentication > Emails > Templates > Confirm sign up (email confirmation is on)

change_email.subject: Confirm your new email · تأكيد بريدك الجديد
change_email.where: Supabase > Authentication > Emails > Templates > Change email address

reauthentication.subject: Your Halala confirmation code · رمز التأكيد في هللة

password_changed.subject: Your Halala password was changed · تم تغيير كلمة مرور هللة
password_changed.where: Supabase > Authentication > Emails > Templates > Password changed (security notification)

email_changed.subject: Your Halala email was changed · تم تغيير بريد هللة
email_changed.where: Supabase > Authentication > Emails > Templates > Email address changed (security notification, sent to the old address)

account_deletion.subject: Your account will be deleted in 30 days · سيُحذف حسابك بعد 30 يومًا

account_reactivated.subject: Your account is active again · حسابك نشط مرة أخرى
